description: Utility functions for automatic Pydantic model conversion in AgentField SDK, enabling FastAPI-like automatic conversion of dictionary arguments to Pydantic models, with functions to check model types, convert dicts to models, and process function arguments based on type hints.

methods.name: bool is_pydantic_model(type_hint: Any)
methods.description: Checks if a type hint is a subclass of Pydantic's BaseModel.

methods.name: bool is_optional_type(type_hint: Any)
methods.description: Determines if a type hint is an Optional (Union with None).

methods.name: Any get_optional_inner_type(type_hint: Any)
methods.description: Extracts the inner type from an Optional type hint.

methods.name: Any convert_dict_to_model(data: Any, model_class: type)
methods.description: Converts a dictionary to a specified Pydantic model, raising ValidationError on failure.

methods.name: Tuple[tuple,dict] convert_function_args( func: callable, args: tuple, kwargs: dict )
methods.description: Converts function arguments to Pydantic models based on type hints, mimicking FastAPI behavior.

methods.name: bool should_convert_args(func: callable)
methods.description: Determines if a function's parameters warrant automatic conversion based on Pydantic models.

ctags.name: convert_function_args
ctags.signature: ( func: callable, args: tuple, kwargs: dict )
